findings.claim: A live grant that names both grantable and retired classes still lists the retired ones as if they were in force. Separately, grant list --all shows a closed historical unclassed grant as 'admits nothing', which misstates what it admitted while it was in force.
findings.evidence: intent_grant_everything.go:272-277: attorneyActs returns strings.Join(entry.Classes) as soon as Carries admits any one class. A live entry naming acks,mechanical,ordering,recovery,stale-releases reads 'acts for wido in acks, mechanical, ordering, recovery, stale-releases'. Carries refuses mechanical and stale-releases, so admission fails safe.
findings.change: Later: list only the classes Carries admits, and mark retired ones as retired.
findings.relation: same-rule-as 3 (R-143-m1e: the person understands the impact first)

findings.claim: The status layout fixture still injects an unclassed entry. The status goldens therefore show the degenerate 'admits nothing' banner as the live grant.
